content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body: $EZPW holding 32.9, the level that capped the August rebound. Below 27.4 the whole base is gone.

queue.headline: Hardware ripping, +2.9% avg on Friday
queue.body: $HPE +12.4% $DELL +12.0% $NTAP +8.5% $HPQ +8.4% $XRX +8.2% $TBCH +8.2% $CRSR +7.7% $SMCI +7.3% Breadth inside the group, not one leader.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.body:
Jobless claims averaging 206k a week, 13.0% below a year ago.
GDPNow tracking 4.4% growth.
Median CPI running 2.1%.
The growth scare keeps paying for not existing.

queue.headline: $RHP back at the line it has spent six months defending.
queue.body: 122, the most-traded price of the past six months, has held again. A close below it removes the only structure standing between this name and the low 100s.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.body: Rep. Cisneros bought $15K to $50K of $GMED on Aug 19, filing hit 22 days later. Congress always runs behind the tape.
